findings.description: This bucket has no default server-side encryption configuration, so newly stored reports are not explicitly protected with SSE/KMS under this Terraform configuration.
This bucket has no default server-side encryption configuration, leaving ledger exports without explicitly enforced encryption at rest.
This bucket has no default server-side encryption configuration, so model artifacts are not explicitly encrypted at rest by bucket policy/configuration.
This bucket has no default server-side encryption configuration, leaving potentially sensitive operational runbooks without explicitly enforced encryption at rest.

The uploaded vendor roster object does not specify server-side encryption, and its destination bucket has no default encryption configuration. The spreadsheet may therefore be stored without explicitly configured encryption at rest.
